instructions: Copy this file to Report/report_observations.json. Do not rename this unfilled template as a final observation record.
Complete every field after reviewing the production logs, prediction plots and final WAV measurements. Set finalized=true only when every sample has an explicit assessment.
For each sample choose assessment_mode=objective_only or listening. Copy wav_sha256 from the current Results/<language>/analysis.json. The builder rejects observations for different WAV bytes.

objective_only requires listening=null. It explicitly leaves pronunciation correctness, intelligibility, naturalness and perceived artifacts unassessed. Do not claim listening from statistical measurements.

listening requires an object with listened_to_final_wav=true, reviewer, reviewed_at (ISO 8601), pronunciation, intelligibility, naturalness, and artifacts. Enter only observations actually made on the identified final WAV.

Write objective_review.duration, pitch, energy and limitations for every sample. Discuss actual measured values or visible prediction behavior; distinguish predicted phone F0/energy from waveform F0/RMS. Note zero-duration phones and long SIL runs when present.

Write all report prose in Roman script. Keep each sample objective_review field to one or two concise sentences (preferably under 300 characters), and each language assessment to a few sentences. Exact Telugu source sentences remain unmodified in Telugu/test_samples.json.
The gate checks completeness, identity and basic schema. It cannot certify the truth of an observer's prose. Never fabricate listening, perceptual quality, convergence or native-speaker judgments.
Run python scripts/build_report.py --check-only before authoring. The final PDF must subsequently be rendered page by page and visually inspected.
